brand.name: Santorini by Georgios
brand.tagline: Greek cooking over open fire, on Las Olas.

hero.headline: Whole fish, wood fire, and a table that isn't in a hurry.
hero.sub: Family recipes from the Cyclades, cooked the long way. Dinner Tuesday through Sunday, brunch on weekends.

story.heading: Three generations, one grill
story.body:
Georgios Stavros learned to cook on his grandmother's terrace in Oia, where dinner started when the boats came in and ended when the wine did. The restaurant keeps her rules: fish from that morning, lamb that has had all day, olive oil from the family's trees, and nobody rushed off a table.

The room opens onto Las Olas Boulevard. Come early for the light, or late for the saganaki.
